structured.answer: I'd pick Harel's "מניות" track: it had the biggest return on the page (24.04% over 3 years, 14.64% over 5), the fee is about the same as the others (0.55%), and it's a big fund (7.3 מיליארד ₪). The "S&P 500" track would be my fallback.

Many tracks show 'פחות מ־3 שנים' instead of a return, so I can't compare them
No call to action or first step for opening the fund
The bigger return on 'מניות' pulls me away from the S&P track my friends talk about, and nothing explains the difference
